[LIMP.3.1.1] When the compiler encounters `import ha`, it
resolves the identifier `ha` to a single `.ds` file via a
build-pipeline-supplied search path or explicit file list.
The mechanism is a compiler invocation concern; the spec
does not commit to a fixed environment variable or
filesystem layout, except for the place of the library the compiler ships with
([LIMP.3.3.1]).
